summary: You can now use the GitHub REST API to find which cost center a user, organization, repository, or enterprise team belongs to. Previously, you had to list every cost center and scan its resources.
takeaways: Access depends on your role: Enterprise owners, billing managers, and GitHub Apps with read access to enterprise billing can look up any resource in the enterprise.
